requirement: Map an add-metric-rule command to a rule: reject a command that sets both or neither of the score function and major/minor flag, map a ScoreFunction into a ScoringRule, otherwise build a MajorMinorRule, and forward formula-mapping failures.

preconditions.text: The mapper is constructed with a formula mapper
The clinical variables are supplied as mapper dependencies

inputs.text: Command with the constant score function 1
Command with a ternary age-band formula referencing a supplied AGE variable
Command mapped through the dependency-less overload
Command that sets both a score function and IsMajor
Command that sets neither a score function nor IsMajor
Command whose score function references an unknown variable

returns.text: Success at ApplicationStatus.Success with a metric rule
A ScoringRule carries the metric, criterion, and mapped score function
A MajorMinorRule carries the metric, criterion, and the requested flag
Failure with BadRequest when the formula references an unknown variable

exception_text: NotImplementedException from the dependency-less overload; ArgumentException when both or neither of the score function and major/minor flag is set
